findings.summary: Test helper extracts the embedded filter via key.substring(key.lastIndexOf('-') + 1, ...), the same unanchored-dash pattern SegmentKey.headerLenOf was specifically fixed to stop using; only works here because the fixture's filter payload happens not to contain a trailing embedded '-'.
findings.failure_scenario: A future edit to this test using a Bloom or larger exact-bitmap filter whose payload tail contains '-' would truncate the substring; MembershipFilter.decode would likely throw rather than silently pass wrong -- low risk, but the same hazard class production code was hardened against.

findings.summary: Same unanchored lastIndexOf('-') extraction pattern, used to pull the embedded filter back out of the key for theFilterIsEmbeddedInTheKeyAndRoundTripsThroughDecode.
findings.failure_scenario: Benign for the All filter fixture used here (no dash in "A"), but fragile if the test is later adapted to a filter type whose payload can end in '-'.
